definitions.gloss: quotation marks; quote marks (punctuation marking quoted text)
definitions.explanation: Punctuation marks used to enclose a direct quotation, dialogue, or word being referred to as a word. In Japanese this most commonly means 「 」 (single brackets) and 『 』 (double brackets); in Western-style writing it refers to " " and ' '.

examples.japanese: {引用符|いんようふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{引用符|いんようふ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧。

⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{引用符|いんようふ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{通常|つうじょう}→通常：27316_tsuujou⟧⟦ダブル→ダブル：24220_daburu⟧クォート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: In English academic papers, double quotes are normally used as quotation marks.

examples.japanese: {引用符|いんようふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{閉|と}じられていない→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧にくく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If quotation marks are not properly closed, the meaning of the whole passage becomes hard to follow.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{引用|いんよう}→引用：01850_inyou⟧ ('quotation; citation') and {符|ふ} ('mark; sign'). Refers to the punctuation marks themselves, not the quoted text — contrast with ⟦{引用文|いんようぶん}→引用文：23771_inyoubun⟧ ('a quotation; the quoted passage').

JAPANESE CONVENTIONS:
- 「 」 (kagi-kakko): the standard Japanese quotation marks, used for dialogue and quoted words
- 『 』 (nijuu-kagi-kakko / double angle brackets): used for quotations inside quotations, titles of books, or titles of films/albums
- " " and ' ' are used in Western-style writing, programming, and mathematical contexts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {引用符|いんようふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to add quotation marks
- {引用符|いんようふ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to enclose in quotation marks
- {引用符|いんようふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧: to close the quotation marks
- {引用符|いんようふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open the quotation marks
- ⟦シングル→シングル：10949_shinguru⟧{引用符|いんようふ}: single quotation marks ('  ')
- ⟦ダブル→ダブル：24220_daburu⟧{引用符|いんようふ}: double quotation marks ("  ")

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引用|いんよう}→引用：01850_inyou⟧: quotation; citation — the action or abstract concept
- ⟦{引用文|いんようぶん}→引用文：23771_inyoubun⟧: a quotation; the quoted text itself
- ⟦{括弧|かっこ}→括弧：00151_kakko⟧: parentheses/brackets (general term) — {引用符|いんようふ} is a subtype used for quotations
- {鉤括弧|かぎかっこ}: the specific term for 「 」

TYPOGRAPHICAL NOTE:
In Japanese typography, quotation marks often do not include trailing spaces, and vertical writing rotates the brackets. Programming languages and data formats typically use Western " " as string delimiters, so this word also appears in tech documentation.
